extraction_notes: Catalytic-test conditions applied to all extracted records: atmospheric pressure; catalyst mass 0.1744 g; WHSV=48 ml gcat-1 h-1; total flow=250 mL min-1; feed H2:CO2:N2=36:9:10, giving H2/CO2=4. The paper also states GHSV values of 43000 and 15000 ml mlcat-1 h-1 for zeolite and SBA-15/MCM-41 samples, respectively; WHSV was entered because it is the constant space-velocity value for all catalysts. Values from Figures 6, 7, and 8 were read approximately from plotted points. Zeolite HNaUSY performance/TOF data were not extracted because the paper identifies those samples/data as previously reported in the literature (reference 6), not newly measured in this study. FTIR-operando spectra were not extracted as catalyst-performance records because they report spectra/adsorbed species rather than CO2 conversion or CH4 selectivity.
